summary.title: Noel (character)
summary.name: Noel
summary.excerpt: Noel is a prodigy who is in charge in Summoners' Research Lab, Frontier Gate, and Training Program. He used the data sent by the Summoner to make Mock Units and test them in the Trials. His father is Rhoa's nephew.

infobox.caption: Artwork from Imperial Capital Randall

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Noel is a prodigy who is in charge in Summoners' Research Lab, Frontier Gate, and Training Program. He used the data sent by the Summoner to make Mock Units and test them in the Trials. His father is Rhoa's nephew.

sections.title: Debut Appearance
sections.content: Noel is first revealed when the Summoner reaches level 50 where he introduces Trials and "Mock Units". Typically, this is where most players encounter him other than Frontier Gate and Grand Quest, and later on, the training grounds, all four of which he runs.

sections.title: In the storyline
sections.content: While not directly involved in the storyline, it was later revealed that the player sent various data about the Four Fallen Gods and Lucius so he could make Mock Units based on the Gods. Later on, Noel is also seen managing the Grand Quests, Frontier Gates, and Training Ground.

sections.title: Personality
sections.content: Noel is seen as having a joking, somewhat cocky personality, based on his interactions with the Summoner. He believes that his creations - the Mock Units - to be stronger than the Summoner, and will mock the Summoner should they fail to defeat one of his creations.

sections.title: Abilities
sections.content: Noel is known for the "Trials" he creates to test "Mock Units" based on gods, major characters, etc. While he claims his copies are nothing compared to the originals, it is likely he is either lying, or less likely, unaware of what they can do. Confirmed in one of the episodes on the Brave Frontier Channel, it was revealed Noel is the creator of the "Omni Evolution," which is a type of evolution that serves as a "what-if" scenario if units took a different path as opposed to the path they took, such as scenarios if the unit did not die. It can also be inferred this evolution is similar in strength than Noel's "Mock Units." Other than this Noel is known for his vast intelligence and knowledge of units and how to create them, despite his young age.

sections.title: Notable Relationships
sections.content: The Summoner- One of the few confirmed relationships that isn't merely knowing a character. Upon first meeting the Summoner, Noel introduces the trial system (Starting at level 50) and "Mock Units" as a whole. Other than this there are few actual interactions other than when, if the Summoner fails a trial, Noel will remark, jokingly, on the level of the Summoner's failure,which could also be Noel saying that the Summoner could do better. These interactions imply that Noel does not think of the Summoner as being powerful - on the contrary, he says he will just call in a new one. These interactions have minor differences depending on the type of trial.

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content:
- According to Brave Frontier Storybook:
- His full name is Noel Grandel.
- His birth date is December 22.
- His height is 146 cm.
- His weight is 37 kg.
- He has an older sister.
